name: status
title: Status
description: Is the data current, and what does each source hold: per source its kind, row counts, latest snapshot, latest transaction and whether newer data is waiting to be loaded. source narrows to one source and adds detail. marks: how far a monthly return can be trusted instead: per month end, marked_pct, the share of value marked within five days, weighted by USD value in every currency. Example: {}.

currency.description: marks only: the output currency of value_marked and value_total.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: marks only: window start. Default: the first month end.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

marks.description: Month ends instead of sources. Takes from, to and currency; no source or verbose.

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: One source id, for its detail and recent loads.

to.description: marks only: window end. Default today.

verbose.description: Add the counts of rows no category, type or asset class could be found for.
